purpose: Continue the unfinished 20-node homogeneous steady-load comparison with one fixed load-specific NSESche map chosen from the complete retained V150 E01-E20 training block and independently frozen V94/V97 mechanism evidence, while reusing the nine frozen baselines without rerunning them.

paper_sequence_gate.existing_later_chapter_artifacts: Retain unchanged for audit; do not execute or use later-chapter outcomes to modify V151 after this commit.

diagnosis.low: The Hiku2/OCS Borda profile exceeded Orion in mean throughput by 0.00495 requests/ms but won only 9/20 throughput pairs; its QPR mean remained 0.004536480435928518 below OCS despite 11/20 positive QPR pairs.
diagnosis.middle: The Hiku/OCS3 Borda profile exceeded FaaSRank in mean throughput by 0.00995 requests/ms and in zero-completed-as-zero QPR by 0.0036583783786291457, but won only 10/20 throughput pairs and one retained seed completed zero requests, so finite QPR covered 19/20.
diagnosis.high: The direct OCS-current-demand profile exceeded Jiagu in mean throughput by 0.1657 requests/ms and QPR by 0.0034506300942135134; both QPR gates passed, while throughput won 11/20 pairs and missed the fixed 12/20 gate by one pair.
diagnosis.solver_observation: Across the complete high-load block, throughput-positive seeds had more rather than fewer Nash assignment moves on average, so V151 does not introduce an initializer-only or move-suppression intervention.

v94_training.evidence: The terminal-OCS/FaaSRank dual-window-safe profile passed throughput and both QPR gates in all three high-density E3 scenarios; the idle-warm steady variant passed all three gates in E4.

v94_confirmation.evidence: The same high-density and steady profiles independently repeated all required V94 gates without pooling training and confirmation seeds.

v97_low_density_training.evidence: The E4 load-least guard64 steady profile passed its three preregistered training gates with at least 27.05% relative mean QPR gain and 5.41% relative mean throughput gain over its frozen anchor.

independent_cross_scenario_evidence.selection_boundary: V150 outcomes identify the load-specific failure modes. The profile mechanisms themselves were registered and evaluated before V151, in independent V94/V97 scenario blocks. No V151 outcome exists or may be inspected before this plan is committed.

load_rationale.low: Use the independently trained low-density steady load-least guard to target V150's low-load QPR deficit without discarding its throughput objective.
load_rationale.middle: Use the independently confirmed steady idle-warm dual anchor to track the FaaSRank ceiling while preventing the all-Hiku/OCS3 collapse observed in one V150 seed.
load_rationale.high: Use the independently confirmed high-density dual anchor to preserve terminal OCS behavior while adding FaaSRank anchoring and window-safe Pareto protection; do not suppress the Nash moves associated with V150 high-load wins.

training_design.candidate_order_rule: Commit one seeded permutation of the exact 60 load-by-seed cells before reference construction; attempt every cell in that order and never reorder after a result or failure.
training_design.technical_retry_rule: Only the frozen same-cell protocol retry policy may retry a technical failure; every failed attempt remains archived.

selection_rule.mean_gate: For each load and metric, the candidate mean must be strictly greater than the maximum mean among all nine frozen non-NSESche baselines.
selection_rule.paired_gate: For each load and metric, candidate minus the preregistered metric-specific ceiling baseline must be strictly positive on at least 12 of 20 paired seeds. Finite-only QPR uses only pairs where both values are finite and additionally requires candidate finite QPR on all 20 seeds; zero-completed-as-zero retains all 20.
selection_rule.per_load_training_pass: All three metric mean gates and all three paired gates pass for that load.
selection_rule.zero_completion: Retain the run; finite-only QPR is unavailable and zero-completed-as-zero QPR is zero; never impute or replace a seed.
selection_rule.failure: Retain the complete V151 block and retire each failed profile unchanged; do not delete, replace, relabel, or selectively rerun any QC-passing seed.

before_reveal: exact 60-cell load-by-E01-E20 product in the committed seeded order
exact load-to-profile map and exact frozen environment
attempt-1 QC pass or only preregistered same-cell technical retries with every failed attempt retained
zero unexplained quarantine, valid ledgers, one runtime identity, exact frozen tapes/environments/common HPA/model/SLA bindings
60 new policy-independent references and exact build/replay pairing
operational profile, native-anchor, direct-initialization, dominance-guard, and window-safe telemetry agree with the manifest
zero candidate throughput, completion, latency, cost, or QPR fields parsed before the blind audit is sealed
